attacks.name: Strike
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character gains |!power| equal to the |!damage| dealt.
|!wild| |*Pierce|: Change 1 of the defender's |!critical|, |!wild|, or |!block| results to a blank.

attacks.name: Spear Throw
steps: After this attack is resolved, Place this character within |!range| 1 of the defender.
|!wild| |*Poison|: After this attack is resolved, the defender gains the |§poison§Poison| special condition.

attacks.name: Quantum Starburst
steps: If this attack deals |!damage|, after this attack is resolved the defender gains the |§bleed§Bleed|, |§poison§Poison|, and |§stun§Stun| special conditions.

superPowers.name: Martial Prowess
superPowers.body: When this character is targeted by an attack within |!range| 2, it may use this superpower. Instead of rolling dice equal to its Defense, it rolls five defense dice. If this character suffers no |!damage| from the attack, after the attack is resolved, the attacker suffers 2 |!damage|.

superPowers.name: Wife of Corvus Glaive
superPowers.body: At the end of this character's activation, if it is within |!range| 3 of an allied |*Corvus Glaive|, this character may use this superpower. If the allied |*Corvus Glaive| does not have an activated token, he may activate before your turn ends.

superPowers.name: Invulnerability
superPowers.body: When this character would suffer |!damage| from an enemy effect, reduce the amount suffered by 1, to a minimum of 1.

Strength increased from 6 to 7 on Quantum Starburst.
Wife of Corvus Glaive's Power Cost increased from 0 to 1.
Wife of Corvus Glaive requires Proxima Midnight to be within |!range| 3 of Corvus Glaive, instead of |!range| 4.
